mission.title: What Expat Platform Does
mission.description: Finland offers world-class innovation, safety, and quality of life, yet international professionals face fragmented bureaucratic silos across registration, taxation, and housing. At the same time, Finnish tech leaders face an acute specialist shortage. Expat Platform eliminates friction by connecting talent, employers, and municipal governments into one seamless digital ecosystem.

talentCard.title: For International Specialists
talentCard.description: A single digital gateway for moving, settling, finding career opportunities, navigating public institutions (DVV, Vero, Kela), and actively participating in municipal democracy.

companyCard.title: For Finnish Employers
companyCard.description: Direct connection to verified international specialists, culturally calibrated Nordic STAR resumes, and structured tools to reduce relocation friction and employee turnover.

municipalityCard.title: For Municipalities & Government
municipalityCard.description: Data-driven integration funnels, talent demographic intelligence, and automated public service request routing for forward-looking Finnish cities.

offerings.title: What We Offer Today
offerings.subtitle: A fully functional civic-tech ecosystem with live production modules already serving the Finnish landscape.

onboarding.title: Civic Onboarding & Relocation Guide
onboarding.description: Dynamic, city-tailored relocation checklists spanning 4 essential phases: from pre-arrival planning to long-term integration. Step-by-step guidance for DVV, Vero tax cards, Kela social insurance, bank accounts, healthcare, and schooling.

careers.title: Career & Talent Matching
careers.description: Curated directory of expat-friendly employers, tech stack filtering, English-speaking workplace cultures, and our Nordic STAR Resume Builder calibrated specifically to Nordic hiring standards.

civic.title: Civic Engagement & Participatory Budgeting
civic.description: Direct democratic inclusion via participatory budgeting (Osallistuva budjetointi) with virtual token voting, municipal sentiment polls, language exchange cafes, and mentorship.

analytics.title: Municipal Requests & B2G Analytics
analytics.description: A direct ticketing channel for citizens to contact municipal departments, combined with high-level analytics dashboards for city councils to monitor integration velocity and talent sentiment.

roadmap.title: What We Will Do Next
roadmap.subtitle: Our strategic expansion plan: securing the Finnish ecosystem before scaling internationally.

phase1.title: Suomi.fi & Public Register Deep Sync
phase1.description: Direct integration with Suomi.fi-tunnistus (Finnish Bank ID / Mobile ID) for automated digital identity verification, plus automated Vero tax card calculation and DVV address sync.

phase2.title: AI Legal & Integration Copilot
phase2.description: A specialized RAG-powered AI advisor trained on Finnish labor laws, collective agreements (TES), and tenancy regulations to provide 24/7 legal guidance in expats' native languages.

phase3.title: Nationwide B2B Employer Portal
phase3.description: A complete enterprise dashboard for Finnish companies to manage international relocations, track visa progress, and collaborate seamlessly with municipal integration houses.

phase4.title: Pan-European Civic Export
phase4.description: Adapting and scaling our proven Finnish civic-tech blueprint to Sweden, Germany, Estonia, and across the EU under European interoperability and digital governance standards.

vision.title: Long-Term Vision & Impact
vision.subtitle: Solving structural challenges today to build resilient, innovative societies for tomorrow.

point1.title: Closing the National Talent Deficit
point1.description: Ensuring Finland's economic vitality and tech leadership by transforming talent attraction from an administrative hurdle into a competitive national advantage.

point2.title: Sustainable Integration & High-Trust Inclusion
point2.description: Lowering expat turnover, accelerating social belonging, and ensuring international specialists build fulfilling, long-term lives in Finnish communities.

point3.title: A Prime European Civic-Tech Standard
point3.description: Proving our model in Europe's most digitally mature public sector to create an exportable standard for municipal digital integration across the continent.

team.title: Built with Vision & Technical Rigor
team.description: Expat was created by engineers and civic-tech leaders dedicated to making Finland the world's most accessible, welcoming, and productive destination for global talent.

cta.title: Ready to Explore the Platform?
cta.subtitle: Discover our active modules, explore relocation guides, and connect with expat-friendly employers across Finland.
